f.title: RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020 apply to every DRM responsible for human medicines
f.statement: RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020 must be observed by all Holders of Registration of Medicines (DRM) in Brazil; the term DRM covers any party responsible for medicines for human use regulated by Anvisa.
f.applicability: All medicines for human use regulated by Anvisa.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Ressalta-se que estes regulamentos devem ser observados por todos os
Detentores de Registro de Medicamento (DRM) no Brasil, sendo que o termo DRM
abrange quaisquer responsáveis pelos medicamentos de uso humano regulados pela
Anvisa.

rows.quote_en: It is emphasised that these regulations must be observed by all Holders of Registration of Medicines (DRM) in Brazil, the term DRM covering any party responsible for medicines for human use regulated by Anvisa.

f.title: Submit the RPBR by International Birth Date at the periodicity of the Portal list
f.statement: After RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020 enter into force, the RPBR, based on the International Birth Date, must be submitted to Anvisa at the periodicity in the list published on the Anvisa Portal.
f.clause: 3.1.2 (RPBR transition from National to International Birth Date)
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

periodicidade disponibilizada em lista publicada no Portal da Anvisa.

f.title: No RPBR need be sent until the periodicity list is published
f.statement: While the list containing the RPBR submission periodicity is not published on the Anvisa website, there is no need to send the reports.
f.clause: 3.1.2 (RPBR transition from National to International Birth Date)
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Enquanto a lista

encaminhamento dos relatórios.

f.title: Submit RPBRs at the Portal periodicity; Anvisa may ask for other periods
f.statement: RPBRs must be submitted to Anvisa at the periodicity made available on the Anvisa Portal; Anvisa may, if necessary, ask DRMs to present an RPBR at periods and time frames other than those previously defined.
f.clause: 3.1.3 (RPBR at other periods, e.g. new indication)
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).
f.exceptions: Anvisa may request RPBRs at other periods and time frames (IN 63/2020 Art. 18 sole paragraph).

f.title: Clones: prepare one consolidated RPBR, filed by every DRM involved, naming the products and companies
f.statement: For clone medicines, one single RPBR must be prepared containing the consolidated information on all medicines (parent and clones); it must be filed by all DRMs involved and specify which products/companies it covers.
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025). Clone medicines.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
De acordo com o art. 11 da IN nº 63/2020, em situações envolvendo medicamentos
clones, 1 (um) único RPBR deve ser elaborado, contendo as informações consolidadas
de todos os medicamentos (matriz e clones), que deve ser peticionado por todos os
DRM envolvidos, com discriminação de quais produtos/empresas estão contemplados
no referido documento.

f.title: Use the RPBR in place of the former Periodic Pharmacovigilance Report (RPF)
f.statement: From the entry into force of RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020, DRMs must follow these regulations for writing the RPBR and presenting it to Anvisa, in place of the Periodic Pharmacovigilance Report (RPF) previously governed by RDC 04/2009 and IN 14/2009.
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:

determinações destas normativas para a redação e a apresentação à Anvisa do RPBR,
em substituição ao Relatório Periódico de Farmacovigilância, anteriormente regido pelas
RDC nº 04/2009 e IN nº 14/2009.

f.title: Present the RPBR within the Portal time frames per active substance (not tied to renewal)
f.statement: The RPBR is a technical document whose preparation is the responsibility of all DRMs; it must be presented to Anvisa within the time frames on the Anvisa Portal according to the active substance, under RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020 (rather than at registration renewal).
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

deve ser apresentado à Anvisa nos prazos informados no Portal da Anvisa, de acordo
com o princípio ativo envolvido, conforme as diretrizes da RDC nº 406/2020 e da IN nº

f.title: Give indications, dosage forms and posologies per active substance in the RPBR
f.statement: The RPBR must provide information on the indications, pharmaceutical forms and posologies, by active substance.
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

f.title: Biological and biosimilar of the same substance at one DRM: one RPBR filed in each linked DATAVISA process
f.statement: A DRM holding the registration of a biological product and a biosimilar with the same active substance shall present one RPBR per active substance with the data of both products, filed in the DATAVISA processes linked to the products.
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025). Biological and biosimilar products of the same active substance held by the same DRM.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Caso um Detentor
de Registro de Medicamento possua o registro de um produto biológico e de um
biossimilar de igual princípio ativo, deverá apresentar um RPBR por princípio ativo, com
os dados de ambos os produtos, devendo este documento ser peticionado nos
processos do DATAVISA vinculados aos produtos.

f.title: Submit pharmacovigilance documents by electronic filing
f.statement: At the time (2020), pharmacovigilance documents continued to be submitted by electronic filing (peticionamento eletrônico).
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

f.statement: The RPBR is submitted under subject code 11818 - Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report; the additional documents are those described in the checklist for that subject code.

f.title: Write the RPBR executive summary, integrated benefit-risk analysis, conclusions and add-on documents in Portuguese
f.statement: Under IN 63/2020 the executive summary must be presented in Portuguese, compiling the most relevant RPBR information and following the model on the Anvisa Portal; the RPBR items "Integrated benefit-risk analysis for approved indications" and "Conclusions and actions" must also be in Portuguese, as must the additional documents listed in the filing checklist.

do Guia E2C do International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) - Periodic Benefit-Risk

f.title: Already-registered medicines may move at once to IN 63 Section III time frames
f.statement: For medicines already registered whose RPBR submission dates were out of step with the global ones, the change of the presentation time frame to IN 63/2020 Section III terms may be treated as immediate from the entry into force of the new regulations.
f.applicability: Superseded version: RPBR answer of the 2020 Q&A, replaced by the Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition (v2.0, July 2025).

f.title: Prepare a Risk Minimisation Plan within the RMP for important risks or missing information
f.statement: Where there are important identified risks, important potential risks or critical missing information that merit additional risk minimisation actions, or when the health authority requests it, a Risk Minimisation Plan must be prepared and filed with Anvisa as part of the Risk Management Plan, at registration or, for medicines already marketed, at any time; these documents replace the former Pharmacovigilance Plan and Risk Minimisation Plan of RDC 04/2009 and IN 14/2009.

Minimização de Risco, a ser peticionado à Anvisa como parte do Plano de
Gerenciamento de Risco, no momento do registro, ou a qualquer tempo, nos casos em
que o medicamento já tenha sido comercializado. Estas documentações devem ser
apresentadas em substituição ao Plano de Farmacovigilância e ao antigo Plano de
Minimização de Risco, anteriormente regidos pelas RDC nº 04/2009 e IN nº 14/2009.

f.title: Generics and similars: check the registration rules for whether an RMP is needed at registration
f.statement: Under RDC 406/2020 Art. 42, DRMs must prepare a Risk Management Plan to be presented at registration in the situations provided for in the regulatory frameworks in force; therefore, for generic and similar medicines, whether the Plan must be presented at registration must be checked in the registration legislation in force for those medicines.

populações que fazem uso do produto.

f.title: Definition: serious adverse event / serious adverse reaction
f.statement: A serious adverse event or serious adverse reaction is any untoward medical occurrence, at any dose, that results in death, risk of death, situations requiring hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, significant or persistent disability, congenital anomaly, or a clinically significant event.

prolongamento de hospitalização já existente, incapacidade significativa ou persistente,
anomalia congênita e evento clinicamente significativo.
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): 1st edition (19/11/2020) of the Anvisa RDC 406/IN 63 Q&A. f.title: Non-serious AEs have no expedited reporting time frame to Anvisa
f.statement: There is no time frame for reporting non-serious adverse event notifications for medicines to Anvisa through its electronic system.

Não há prazo para reporte à Anvisa, por meio de sistema eletrônico disponibilizado pela

Benefício-Risco, incluindo-se casos de literatura.

f.title: Report fatal adverse events within the Art. 30 time frame
f.statement: Because the serious AE definition (RDC 406/2020 Art. 2) includes death, adverse events resulting in death must be reported to Anvisa within the Art. 30 time frame, according to its criteria.

f.statement: Urgent situations relating to the use of the DRM's products that affect patient safety must be reported to Anvisa within 72 (seventy-two) hours, under RDC 406/2020 Art. 34 §1.

f.title: Use Notivisa until VigiMed Empresas access is granted (2020 transition)
f.statement: While access to VigiMed Empresas had not been granted, companies without registration shall use Notivisa, the adverse event notification system then provided by Anvisa and being gradually replaced by VigiMed, to comply with RDC 406/2020.

f.title: Send notifications to VigiMed Empresas (or Notivisa until access) under RDC 406 Art. 26
f.statement: Anvisa is part of the SNVS; under RDC 406/2020 Art. 26, notifications must be sent to VigiMed Empresas, or to Notivisa while access to the new system has not been granted.

f.title: Outsourced PV providers must comply with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and may be inspected
f.statement: A third party to which pharmacovigilance activities are outsourced must comply with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices regulation.

f.title: RFV: available full time, health-field degree, proven PV experience and knowledge, working in Brazil
